headline: Living Wage & Decent Work Specialist | Supply Chain Sustainability | International Development
summary: Program Officer and subject-matter lead on living wages and living income at IDH Solutions, working with global partners including Unilever, Ingka (IKEA), the UN Global Compact, and ILO Better Work to translate social commitments into measurable action across supply chains. Background spans operational management, humanitarian data systems at War Child Holland, and a human rights internship at OHCHR Geneva. Combines technical depth in wage-gap methodology with multi-stakeholder convening at C-suite and intergovernmental level.
top_skills: Human Rights Due Diligence (UNGPs, OECD Guidelines)
Stakeholder management at C-suite and institutional level
MEAL frameworks and programme quality assurance

frameworks: UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs)

flagship_project.name: UN Global Compact Forward Faster – Living Wages Flagship Training
flagship_project.description: Coordinated and delivered IDH's flagship living wages training under the UN Global Compact Forward Faster initiative, convening a cohort of global companies and international experts to build institutional capacity on wage-gap measurement and credible action. Served as principal IDH liaison and content lead, designing training architecture and ensuring alignment with UN Global Compact standards and ILO Better Work methodologies.
